about: Shot list for the homepage preview (scripts/capture-preview.mjs), recorded from AUTOMOTIVE / ONE. Each segment opens the simulation at a deep link, as a visitor would, waits until the car is built and every material compiled, and renders frames on its frame-stepped clock (?virt=1: every frame is exactly 1/30 s). Setup frames are simulated without drawing (__fabAdvance(n, false)). Lesson segments seek their lesson to a step the way the scrubber does. The clip loops without a cut.

segments.name: intro
segments.about: The S-1 sedan in its studio, the camera drifting slowly.

segments.name: cutaway
segments.about: The engine in cutaway: compression, the spark, and the flame driving the piston down.

setup.eval: (() => { const p = window.__fab.player; const b = p.beats.find((x) => x.beat.id === 'compression'); p.seek(b.start + 3.2); })()

segments.name: torque
segments.about: Pulling away: torque flows from the crankshaft through the gearbox and driveshaft to the rear wheels.

segments.name: exploded
segments.about: The car taken apart into its systems.

setup.eval: (() => { const p = window.__fab.player; const b = p.beats.find((x) => x.beat.id === 'explode'); p.seek(b.start + 0.05); })()
